title: Snowflake
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <!-- Main 6 arms -->
    <g stroke="#7fdbff" stroke-width="4.5" fill="none">
      <!-- vertical -->
      <line x1="50" y1="12" x2="50" y2="88"/>
      <!-- diagonals -->
      <line x1="17" y1="31" x2="83" y2="69"/>
      <line x1="83" y1="31" x2="17" y2="69"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Branch details on each arm -->
    <g stroke="#a0e8ff" stroke-width="3.5" fill="none">
      <!-- vertical top branches -->
      <line x1="50" y1="25" x2="40" y2="17"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="25" x2="60" y2="17"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="38" x2="43" y2="33"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="38" x2="57" y2="33"/>
      <!-- vertical bottom branches -->
      <line x1="50" y1="75" x2="40" y2="83"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="75" x2="60" y2="83"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="43" y2="67"/>
      <line x1="50" y1="62" x2="57" y2="67"/>
      <!-- diagonal top-left arm branches -->
      <line x1="30" y1="38" x2="27" y2="27"/>
      <line x1="30" y1="38" x2="39" y2="29"/>
      <line x1="22" y1="34" x2="20" y2="26"/>
      <!-- diagonal top-right arm branches -->
      <line x1="70" y1="38" x2="73" y2="27"/>
      <line x1="70" y1="38" x2="61" y2="29"/>
      <line x1="78" y1="34" x2="80" y2="26"/>
      <!-- diagonal bottom-left arm branches -->
      <line x1="30" y1="62" x2="27" y2="73"/>
      <line x1="30" y1="62" x2="39" y2="71"/>
      <line x1="22" y1="66" x2="20" y2="74"/>
      <!-- diagonal bottom-right arm branches -->
      <line x1="70" y1="62" x2="73" y2="73"/>
      <line x1="70" y1="62" x2="61" y2="71"/>
      <line x1="78" y1="66" x2="80" y2="74"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Center hexagon -->
    <polygon points="50,42 57,46 57,54 50,58 43,54 43,46" fill="#d4f4ff" stroke="#7fdbff" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Center sparkle -->
    <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="3" fill="#ffffff"/>
    <!-- Tip dots -->
    <g fill="#d4f4ff">
      <circle cx="50" cy="12" r="3.5"/>
      <circle cx="50" cy="88" r="3.5"/>
      <circle cx="17" cy="31" r="3.5"/>
      <circle cx="83" cy="69" r="3.5"/>
      <circle cx="83" cy="31" r="3.5"/>
      <circle cx="17" cy="69" r="3.5"/>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
